Ideas on screen

This week we moved from journeys to early screens, exploring different design directions for the Single Pane of Glass (SPOG) platform and sharing them for feedback with the core HID team in our first design review.

What we got up to
  • Discovery interview with ATOS
  • Mapped what the platform needs to do (draft information architecture)
  • Designed early directions for the platform
  • Starting recruitment on the four research sprints, running to late November
Coming next
